definitions.rationale: Expands the named sortThirdBody statement term into the exact translated loop body; it is a named proof-term definition.
definitions.text:
rule sortThirdBody
    => If(Compare(BinOp("%", Name("i"), Int(3)),
                  CmpOp("==", Int(0))),
         Expr(
           Call(
             Attribute(Name("result"), "append"),
             Subscript(
               Name("thirds"),
               BinOp("//", Name("i"), Int(3))))),
         Expr(
           Call(
             Attribute(Name("result"), "append"),
             Name("value"))))
       AugAssign(Name("i"), "+", Int(1))
       .Stmts

definitions.rationale: Expands the named sortThirdFunctionBody term into the translated function statements, including initialization, loop, and return.
definitions.text:
rule sortThirdFunctionBody
    => Expr(Str("Sort the elements whose indices are divisible by three."))
       Assign(
         Name("thirds"),
         Call(
           Name("sorted"),
           Subscript(Name("l"), Slice(NoBound, NoBound, Int(3)))))
       Assign(Name("result"), ListExpr(.Exprs))
       Assign(Name("i"), Int(0))
       Assign(Name("value"), NoneVal)
       For(Name("value"), Name("l"), sortThirdBody)
       Return(Name("result"))
       .Stmts

definitions.rationale: Defines the named sortThirdClosure proof term as the closure value for the already defined function body.
Defines sortThirdModule as the module AST containing the translated sort_third function.
definitions.text:
rule sortThirdModule
    => Module(
         FuncDef(
           "sort_third",
           Params("l"),
           sortThirdFunctionBody))

definitions.rationale: Defines the divisible-by-three branch of the thirdValue selector by indexing the sorted every-third subsequence.
definitions.text:
rule thirdValue(_:Val, SORTED:ValSeq, I:Int)
    => valSeqAt(SORTED, (I -Int pyMod(I, 3)) /Int 3)
    requires pyMod(I, 3) ==Int 0

definitions.rationale: Defines the complementary thirdValue branch, preserving the original value when the index is not divisible by three.
definitions.text:
rule thirdValue(V:Val, _:ValSeq, I:Int) => V
    requires pyMod(I, 3) =/=Int 0

definitions.rationale: Defines the empty-input base case of the sortThirdAcc mathematical fold.
Defines the nonempty recursive case of sortThirdAcc by advancing the index and extending the accumulated output.
definitions.text:
rule sortThirdAcc(vCons(V:Val, REST:ValSeq), SORTED:ValSeq,
                    I:Int, ACC:ValSeq)
    => sortThirdAcc(
         REST,
         SORTED,
         I +Int 1,
         valSeqConcat(
           ACC,
           vCons(thirdValue(V, SORTED, I), .ValSeq)))

definitions.rationale: Defines the empty-input base case of the lastLoopValue structural helper.
Defines the nonempty recursive case of lastLoopValue by retaining the most recently traversed element.
Defines the top-level sortThird summary by initializing sortThirdAcc with the trusted sorted stride-three slice and an empty accumulator.
definitions.text:
rule sortThird(INPUT:ValSeq)
    => sortThirdAcc(
         INPUT,
         sortVS(buildVS(INPUT, 0, vsLen(INPUT), 3)),
         0,
         .ValSeq)
